sections.heading: More About Central Government Interest Subsidy Scheme
Features of the CSIS Scheme
content: The HDFC Bank Central Sector Interest Subsidy (CSIS) Scheme aims to make higher education accessible by providing interest subsidies on Education Loans. Key features include:
Subsidy Coverage: Full interest subsidy on the loan amount during the moratorium period (course duration plus one year or six months after getting a job, whichever is earlier).
Eligibility: Students from economically weaker sections (EWS) with a gross annual parental income of up to ₹4.5 lakh.
Loan Limit: Applicable for loans up to ₹10 lakhs for studies in India.
Courses Covered: Professional and technical courses in recognizsed institutions in India.
Moratorium Period: Subsidy applicable only during the moratorium period; repayment starts after this period.

sections.heading: Benefits of the CSIS Scheme
content: The HDFC Bank CSIS Scheme offers several benefits:
Financial Relief: Reduces the financial burden on students from EWS by covering interest during the moratorium period.
Encourages Higher Education: Promotes higher education among economically weaker sections, enabling students to pursue professional and technical courses.
Improved Accessibility: Makes education loans more accessible and affordable.
Government Support: Provides government backing, ensuring the scheme's credibility and reliability.
Career Advancement: This program helps students complete their education without immediate financial pressure, allowing them to focus on career growth after graduation.

sections.heading: How to apply for the CSIS Scheme?
content: How to apply for the CSIS Scheme?
To apply for the HDFC Bank CSIS Scheme:
Loan Application: Visit the nearest HDFC Bank branch or apply online for an education loan.
Documentation: Submit necessary documents, including proof of admission, income certificate (to verify EWS status), identity proof, and address proof.
Eligibility Check: Ensure that you meet the scheme's eligibility criteria (EWS status and course requirements).
Subsidy Application: Indicate your interest in the CSIS Scheme during the loan application process.
Verification: The bank will verify the submitted documents and eligibility.
Approval and Disbursement: The loan will be disbursed upon approval, and the interest subsidy will be applied during the moratorium period.

sections.heading: What is the CSIS scheme?
content: This CSIS Scheme for Education Loan offers interest subsidies to students from the Economically Weaker Section (EWS) category who are pursuing professional/technical courses in India. It applies to all Scheduled Banks associated with the current Model Educational Loan.

sections.heading: What is the maximum amount of CSIS Education Loan?
content: What is the maximum amount of CSIS Education Loan?

Under the CGFSEL, the Central Government provides guarantee for Education loans obtained by students, without requiring any collateral security or third-party guarantee, up to a maximum loan limit of ₹7.5 lakh.

sections.heading: How do I claim my Education Loan subsidy?
content: How do I claim my Education Loan subsidy?

All students whose annual family income from all sources does not exceed ₹4.5 lakh per annum are eligible.
